picks.title: Honor Robot Phone hands-on: A gimbal phone experiment with promising results
picks.excerpt: Honor crammed a gimbal camera into a phone in a promising hardware experiment.
picks.rationale: A phone whose camera head physically moves — the clearest hands-on look yet at what industrial design does when AI hardware starts to actuate.

picks.title: Android 17 QPR2 Beta 4 puts AI agents under supervision with new dashboard
picks.excerpt: Google's latest Android 17 QPR2 beta introduces an Agent section in Settings to keep tabs on agentic features running on your device.
picks.rationale: An OS-level supervision UI for on-device agents is a brand-new interaction pattern designers will have to account for in every app.

picks.title: Apple will be launching its first pair of smart glasses next year: Here's what's coming
picks.excerpt: As soon as next year, Apple will be debuting its first pair of AI-powered smart glasses. They'll integrate Visual Intelligence...
picks.rationale: Apple entering camera glasses resets the AI-wearable category around a mass-market industrial-design player — a roadmap worth planning against now.

picks.title: Framework's 192 GB Ryzen AI Max 400 desktop inches closer to launch
picks.excerpt: Framework has revealed more details about its upcoming Desktop configuration powered by AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 Gorgon Halo APU. Alongside support for up to 192 GB of unified memory, the system offers around 6.6% more memory bandwidth than the existing Strix Halo model.
picks.rationale: 192 GB of unified memory in a repairable desktop redefines the personal AI workstation — big local models without a cloud bill.

picks.title: New Dev Tool From Meta Enables AI to Quickly Test Quest Games
picks.excerpt: Meta has introduced Meta XR Operator, an experimental tool designed to let AI coding agents autonomously build, test, debug, and visually verify VR apps.
picks.rationale: AI agents that build, run and visually verify VR builds change the XR QA loop — the first credible agentic step into spatial prototyping.
